boardDescription: Upcoming trips. Open a departure to work through its roster, readiness, prep list, and manifest.

notices.copied: Copied — the new departure has no divers or crew yet.
notices.invalid: That didn’t save — check the date, times, and seats, then try again.
notices.endBeforeStart: The trip has to end after it starts — check the times.
notices.notAuthorized: Building the board is limited to owners, managers, and instructors.
notices.notFound: That departure is no longer on the board.
notices.notScheduled: A cancelled trip can’t be moved. Reinstate it from its own page first.
notices.alreadySailed: The crew has already counted heads against this departure, so it stays where it is. Cancel it from its own page if the day is off.
notices.hasRoster: Divers have booked this departure, so it can’t be deleted. Cancel it from its own page — that keeps the roster and the refund story.
notices.addedSeries: “{title}” is on the board — {count, plural, one {# trip} other {# trips}} scheduled.

builder.heading: The board
builder.description: Add a departure, slide one to another day, copy it forward, or take it off. Open a trip for its dives, crew, and roster.
builder.rollCallOpenAria: Finish the dive {dive} roll call for {ref}
builder.rollCallOpenNote: Back at the dock with the dive {dive} roll call still open.
builder.removeConfirm: Take “{title}” off the board for good?
builder.priceDescription: Divers see this the moment the departure reaches the public page. Leave it empty to price it later on the trip.
builder.multiDayNote: All {count} days move together, keeping their gaps.
builder.copyDescription: Same dive, same seats, same price — no divers and no crew.
builder.moreOptionsDescription: Description, multi-day, deposit, free-cancellation window, and repeating dates.
builder.viewOnlyNotice: Scheduling and editing trips is limited to owners, managers, and instructors. The crew runs the day on the water — the roster, check-in, manifest, and roll call — from each trip's own page.
builder.courseNote: {requirement} · add an instructor before sharing the session
builder.descriptionPlaceholder: Sites, conditions, who it's for, required certs.
builder.daysDescription: Most departures are one day. A course weekend or a liveaboard that meets the same hours on consecutive days is a single trip — one roster, one set of waivers, one crew.
builder.payAtBookingDescription: Optional. When the trip is priced and the shop takes card payments, divers pay online as they book. Leave the deposit blank to charge the full fare up front.
builder.depositDescription: Charged now; the balance is still owed at the dock. Many shops set 20–30% of the fare.
builder.depositTitle: Only applies when set below the trip price.
builder.cancellationWindowDescription: Hours before departure a diver can cancel for a refund. Shown to divers; refunds stay staff-run. 48 hours is a common window.
builder.repeatDescription: Put the same trip on the board for several weeks at once. Each date is created as its own trip — book, crew, and edit them one at a time.
